summary: Selects a sub-object pointer by a mode field at this+0x34 (this[13]) and then applies per-argument parameter dispatch for a2, a3 and a4, each of which selects between two contexts via -1/1. The -1 paths are associated with global byte_5EA55C and the 1 paths with global byte_5BE870. Selected sub-object gets virtual calls at vtable slot +12 (a3 block) and +16 (a4 block) carrying the chosen parameter byte and a float produced by ShortComputation_84a0. Case 4 of the selector computes the sub-object pointer as this+0x20 + 200 * this+0x3C. The decompilation shows several dispatch registers (v6, v7, v10, v11) uninitialized, so the vtable base of those calls is unresolved.

operations.description: Select the active sub-object pointer by switching on mode this+0x34 (this[13]): cases 0..8 read this+0x10..this+0x30 (this[4]..this[12]); case 4 computes base this+0x20 (this[8]) + 200 * this+0x3C (this[15]); any other mode returns early.
If the selected sub-object pointer is null, return without dispatching.
Arguments a2, a3 and a4 each select between -1 (byte_5EA55C context) and 1 (byte_5BE870 context); any other value skips that parameter block.
a2 == 1: run ShortComputation_84a0 then CollisionCoefficientApplication(byte_5BE870, ...) (the second argument is an uninitialized register in the decompilation).
a3 == -1 selects byte_5EA55C; a3 == 1 selects byte_5BE870 as the parameter byte passed to the first virtual call.

Invoke a __thiscall virtual call at vtable slot +12 on the selected sub-object with (obj, parameter_byte, 0, float from ShortComputation_84a0); the vtable base register is uninitialized in the decompilation, so the slot origin is assumed.
a4 == -1: run ShortComputation_84a0 and return the result of the virtual call at vtable slot +16 with (obj, byte_5BE870, 1, float).
a4 == 1: run ShortComputation_84a0 and return the result of the virtual call at vtable slot +16 with (obj, byte_5EA55C, 1, float).
Default switch case and an a4 value other than -1/1 return result (the mode value) unchanged.
